questions.question: What was the INR value before the most recent one, and when was it measured?
Has there been any documented bleeding or bruising since warfarin initiation or dose change?
Was a fall risk assessment or mobility evaluation performed given anticoagulation?
Are there any documented drug interactions with warfarin (e.g., antibiotics, NSAIDs, amiodarone)?
Was patient education on warfarin provided, and when?
